title: Ordering Food and Dining Out
summary: Learn polite phrases for ordering food at a restaurant, asking for recommendations, and paying the bill.

activities.title: Favorite Meals
activities.instructions: Discuss your favorite restaurant experience and what dishes you enjoy ordering.
activities.content: Secret note: Ask partner if they prefer dining in or takeaway.

activities.title: At the Bistro
activities.instructions: Roleplay a diner ordering lunch from a waiter using polite English expressions.
activities.content: Gated waiter menu prompt with hidden price calculation questions.

vocabulary.example: We ordered garlic bread as an appetizer.
Could we please have the bill when you are ready?
